5. Foreign Students — Hostel Note
Foreign students are charged USD 1,000 per year (USD 500 per semester) as room charges. The other fees are
stated by MUET as being the same as the applicable fees above.

6. Important RAG Rules
1. Always identify the fee category: admission, semester, hostel allocation, or hostel semester fee.
2. Always preserve the frequency (once, per year, per semester) when answering students.
3. Clearly identify refundable amounts such as caution money and room deposit.
4. Do not combine one-time and recurring fees into a single figure unless the calculation is explicitly requested.
5. Before answering a time-sensitive fee question, prefer the latest official MUET fee page/prospectus because MUET
reserves the right to change its policies and fee structure.
6. If a student asks about a specific batch/session, use the prospectus for that session when available rather than
assuming the general fee page applies unchanged.
